Quick technical note:
- For the load test, we'll prepare two model variants (standard fp16 and a quantized low-memory variant) and keep routing rules ready so we can toggle without restarting the runtime. That will help show cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Please flag any prompts that include streaming or function/tool calling; those change how we warm KV caches and measure latency.
- If you can provide a representative prompt mix (tokens per request, % that call external tools), we can configure batch sizing and pre-warm caches for the test.

If we need more than 90 minutes to do deep routing validation, let's plan a follow-up session focused on routing policies — otherwise we can cover the basics and create an action item list.
